title: Ancient Chinese diagram of twin serpent creators as a double helix

tellings.quote: I found a diagram from ancient China going back 600 years in China

plain: An old Chinese diagram is said to show twin serpent creator gods twisted around each other like a double helix, the spiral-ladder shape of DNA. The writer Peter Levenda says he found it himself, calling it "a diagram from ancient China going back 600 years," and he points to a work called Stairway to Heaven. If true, people long ago drew something that looks like the shape of life's genetic code.
